purpose: One truthful compatibility contract for Hosted and BareMetal editions across Linux, FreeBSD, Windows and macOS hosts.

hosted.execution_model: user-space host bridge; does not replace or emulate the host kernel

capabilities.filesystem: host filesystem through explicit path and permission adapters
capabilities.network: host sockets; routing changes require separate privileged adapter
capabilities.services: systemd/OpenRC/runit on Linux, rc.d on FreeBSD, SCM on Windows, launchd on macOS
capabilities.desktop: host-native opener and optional Aurora bridge; no claim of full foreign desktop API emulation
capabilities.binary_abi: inspect ELF, PE and Mach-O; execute only through a matching native host or validated emulator

hosted.architecture_policy: 32-bit host support is limited to compatible 32-bit user-space tools; macOS remains 64-bit only; no cross-bitness library loading.

baremetal.execution_model: boots Koronos directly; host OS is build/flash environment only

capabilities.driver_support: only hardware with a matched, validated Chimera driver; host driver binaries are not loaded into Koronos
capabilities.network: Spotnik stack and supported native drivers; advanced routing requires a validated routing service backend

linux.notes: Package manager and service manager are detected; apt is not assumed.
linux.service_adapter_status: systemd and OpenRC lifecycle; apt package installation is provided by the Linux service manager; runit/s6/SysV adapters remain planned

freebsd.notes: Use kqueue, PF, routing sockets and BSD-specific interfaces through dedicated adapters; Linux netlink and systemd are not assumed.
freebsd.service_adapter_status: FreeBSD rc.d/sysrc lifecycle adapter implemented; OpenBSD/NetBSD are not claimed

windows.notes: Use Winsock, Windows service APIs and native filesystem semantics; do not assume POSIX fork, signals or Unix sockets.
windows.service_adapter_status: Windows Service Control Manager lifecycle adapter implemented; Task Scheduler is not exposed

macos.notes: Use Darwin/BSD sockets, launchd, APFS-aware filesystem APIs and hardened-runtime constraints; do not assume Linux syscalls.
macos.service_adapter_status: launchd system/gui lifecycle adapter implemented; plist installation is not exposed

network: privileged route mutation through capability broker

compatibility_tiers.implemented: Code and tests exist for the named adapter path.
compatibility_tiers.partial: An interface or subset exists; unsupported calls must return an explicit not-supported result.
compatibility_tiers.planned: Specification only; do not advertise as operational.

non_claims: This matrix does not claim full Windows NT, FreeBSD, Linux or XNU kernel equivalence.
It does not claim complete Win32, POSIX, BSD or Darwin syscall coverage.
It does not imply every listed filesystem, driver, routing protocol or executable ABI is implemented.
The x86-64 interrupt/syscall/SMP production blockers remain independent.
